title: Key fob and digital key use
summary: Feedback about key access centers on digital key convenience, some key fob reliability complaints, and many informational or situational comments about setup, sharing, and daily use.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the convenience of the digital key and a trunk safeguard that prevents locking key fobs inside.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe key fob issues such as early battery replacement needs, poor detection range, and related alarm problems.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mostly cover questions, instructions, preferences, and situations involving digital key setup, backup use, key sharing, and leaving fobs in the vehicle without a clear evaluative stance.

limitations: Most sampled fragments in this topic are undetermined, which limits how confidently the sample shows clear satisfaction or dissatisfaction.
The topic combines product experiences with how-to guidance, ownership logistics, and hypothetical questions, so not all fragments reflect direct usage outcomes.
Examples are limited to the provided fragments, so finer distinctions between digital key issues and key fob issues are not always clear.
